\[
F_0 = H_{SF}(y),\quad F_{DF} = H_{DF}(F_0),\quad \hat{x} = y + H_{REC}(F_{DF} + F_0),\quad
\operatorname{Attention}(Q, K, V) = \operatorname{SoftMax}\!\left(\frac{Q K^{\top}}{\sqrt{d}} + B\right) V
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(y\): The noisy image
- \(H_{SF}, H_{DF}, H_{REC}\): Shallow features, deep features and reconstruction
- \(Q, K, V\): Queries, keys and values of the pixels in one window
- \(d\): The length of each query and key
- \(B\): The learned bias for relative positions in the window
- \(\hat{x}\): The restored image

y is the noisy image. A convolution H_SF gives shallow features. Six residual Swin Transformer groups H_DF give deep features. In each block, attention compares the pixels inside a window of 8 x 8 pixels, with a learned bias B for their relative position. Every second block shifts the windows by 4 pixels, so information crosses window borders. A last convolution H_REC turns the features into a correction, which is added to the image.
